answer: Smart-meter load-signature attestation anchors each identity to one household electricity meter. Each epoch the meter signs a fresh load curve — kettle spikes at dawn, a heater's ember glow at night, the nectar-sweet noon dip of an empty house — checked against the pattern. No two homes share a curve: the ocean of appliance on-off events is a fingerprint no script fakes cheaply. A farm running a hundred puppets on one meter reports one identical curve, collapses to one vote, and burns its stake. Faking N identities needs N real homes, N meters, N power bills; honest homes hum once per epoch.
